name: Hollow Guard
description: An animated suit of rusted plate armor bound by necrotic embers, patrolling forgotten ruins.

abilities.name: Halberd Sweep
abilities.description: A wide, crushing arc with a corroded polearm.

name: Thorn Stalker
description: A gaunt, bark-skinned beast whose limbs bristle with venomous briars.

abilities.name: Briar Lunge
abilities.description: Springs from cover to rake its target with barbed claws.

name: Cinder Wisp
description: A hovering sphere of pale witchfire that feeds on stray sparks of magic.

abilities.name: Searing Flare
abilities.description: Releases a blinding pulse of arcane heat.

name: Ashen Warden
description: A towering fallen knight clad in scorched obsidian mail, wielding a greatsword of grey iron.

abilities.name: Cinder Cleave
abilities.description: Brings down a heavy greatsword wreathed in smoldering ash.
